        } else {

                if (id.toUpperCase().contains("THREE")) { threeId = id; break; }
            }
            if (threeId != null) {
                sequence = records.get(threeId).toString();
            } else if (records.size() == 1) {
                sequence = records.values().iterator().next().toString();
            } else {
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                for (StringBuilder b : records.values()) sb.append(b);
                sequence = sb.toString();
            }
        }
        sequence = sequence.toUpperCase();
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        appendFrequencies(out, sequence, 1);
        appendFrequencies(out, sequence, 2);
        appendCount(out, sequence, "GGT");
        appendCount(out, sequence, "GGTA");
        appendCount(out, sequence, "GGTATT");
        appendCount(out, sequence, "GGTATTTTAATT");
        appendCount(out, sequence, "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT");
        System.out.print(out);
    }

    static void appendFrequencies(StringBuilder out, String seq, int k) {
        int n = seq.length();
        HashMap<String, Integer> freq = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i + k <= n; i++) {
            String key = seq.substring(i, i + k);
            Integer c = freq.get(key);
            freq.put(key, c == null ? 1 : c + 1);
        }
        List<Map.Entry<String, Integer>> list = new ArrayList<>(freq.entrySet());
        Collections.sort(list, new Comparator<Map.Entry<String, Integer>>() {
            public int compare(Map.Entry<String, Integer> a, Map.Entry<String, Integer> b) {
                int c = b.getValue() - a.getValue();
                if (c != 0) return c;
                return a.getKey().compareTo(b.getKey());
            }
        });
        int total = n - k + 1;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : list) {
            out.append(e.getKey()).append(' ');
            out.append(String.format(Locale.US, "%.3f", 100.0 * e.getValue() / total));
            out.append('\n');
        }
        out.append('\n');
    }

    static void appendCount(StringBuilder out, String seq, String frag) {
        int count = 0;
        int idx = 0;
        int fl = frag.length();
        while (idx + fl <= seq.length()) {
            int found = seq.indexOf(frag, idx);
            if (found < 0) break;
            count++;
            idx = found + 1;
        }
        out.append(count).append('\t').append(frag).append('\n');
    }
}
